verdict.rationale: OpenCode's GitHub integration documents that, when you mention /opencode or /oc in a comment, the agent works in a new branch and submits a PR with all the changes, running inside your GitHub Actions runner. That covers creating branches and opening pull requests, but staging and commit-message authoring are only implied. The evidence also never shows these git operations in local terminal sessions. missing for 10: explicit documentation of staging and commit-message generation, evidence of branch/PR workflows outside the GitHub Actions comment trigger, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have the agent stage changes, write commit messages, create branches, and open pull requests

citations.quote: Ask OpenCode to fix an issue or implement a feature. And it will work in a new branch and submits a PR with all the changes.
Mention /opencode or /oc in your comment, and OpenCode will execute tasks within your GitHub Actions runner.
